newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber tumbles on near-term oversupply trend.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber tumbles on near-term oversupply trend.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended sharply lower on Wednesday due to the yen's strength against the dollar and near-term oversupply trends, traders said.
Newly listed benchmark December closed at 124.5 yen per kg after opening at 126.9 yen. Other prices ranged from 3.8 yen to 4.7 yen lower.

The market started weaker with bearish sentiment carried over from Tuesday. "There are concerns that significant amounts of lower-quality rubber would be delivered at the spot expiry later in July," one trader said. "Prices are likely to drift lower in the near future," he said.
